messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: Plot x y z format data.
parts:
Hi,

I have a set of integer coordinate x,y, associated with each
coordinate there is a z value. If a grid is not available, then the z
value is zero. Is there a convenient function to plot a heatmap for
this type of data? (I know that I can write the data into a matrix and
use image(), but I'm wondering if there is any simpler to do so.)
Thanks!

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Plot x y z format data.
parts:
The convient function is... ggplot (what do you expect, this is the
ggplot2 list after all). Asumming I understand your question
correctly:

dat <- expand.grid(x=1:10, y=1:10)
dat$z <- rnorm(100)

ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=z)) + geom_tile()

ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=z)) + geom_raster()

Best,
Ista
